body: I come in many colors, so beautiful and bright, I turn homes into a beautiful sight. What am I?
I come in many different colors and I get bigger when I’m full. I will float away if you don’t tie me down and I will make a loud sound if I break. What am I?
I come in many shapes and colors. I sing in the breeze but only live 7 months. What am I?
I come in many shapes, sizes and colors. I stick to many surfaces but I am, in fact, not sticky at all. What am I?
I come in winter. I cannot see, hear, or feel. I can't eat but you can eat parts of me?
I come off a beautiful creature, which soars in the sky. I come off a peckish creature, which has a tail as mighty as the sun! I am sometimes dirty and parents beg you not to pick me up. What am I?
I come out of the earth, I am sold in the market. He who buys me cuts my tail, takes off m suit of silk and weeps beside me when I am dead?
I come with a train and go with a train and the train doesn't need me but can't go without me. What am I?
I come without being fetched at night, hides away as soon as daylight strikes. Although I may look small, I am much mightier than what you can imagine. What am I?
I consist mostly of lettuce, along with a variety of other veggies. Ranch is one of my popular dressings. What am I?
I consist of several parts. Two slices of bread, usually cheese and some kind of lunch meat. What am I?
I contain five little items of an everyday sort. You can find all five in a tennis court. What am I?
I contain six letters, minus one and you got twelve. What am I?
I contain words about words, some of which you've never heard. What am I?
I cost no money to use, or conscious effort to take part of. And as far as you can see, there is nothing to me. But without me, you are dead?
I count time but have no end. Tick tick but I am not a clock. What am I?
I cover reality and hide what is true but may bring out the courage in you. What am I?
I cover what is real and hide what is true but sometimes I bring out the courage in you?
I cover what is real and hide what is true. But sometimes I bring out the courage in you. What am I?
I cover what's real, hide what is true but sometimes bring out the courage in you. What am I?
I cover what’s real; hide what is true but sometimes bring out the courage in you. What am I?
I cracked by Indiana Jones. What am I?
I crawl on the earth and rise on a pillar?
I crawl on the earth and rise on a pillar. What am I?
I crawl on the earth. And rise on a pillar?
I crushed on Wendy Darling. What am I?
I cut through evil like a double edged sword and chaos flees at my approach. Balance I single-handedly upraise, through battles fought with heart and mind, instead of with my gaze?
I cut through evil like a double edged sword and chaos flees at my approach. Balance I single-handedly upraise, through battles fought with heart and mind, instead of with my gaze. What am I?
I dance and sing in the breeze but I have neither voice nor feet. What am I?
I dance on one feet and knows only one shape. Someone with same name as me is very good with directions. What am I?
I describe a toilet cleaner as well as one of Santa's reindeer. What am I?
I destroy your home from inside out. What am I?

I dig out tiny caves and store gold and silver in them. I also build bridges of silver and make crowns of gold. Sooner or later everybody needs my help, yet many people afraid to let me help them. What am I?

I dig out tiny caves and store gold and silver in them. I also build bridges of silver and make crowns of gold. They are the smallest you could imagine. Sooner or later everybody needs my help. Yet many people are afraid to let me help them?
I direct you from outer space. What am I?
I do not breathe but I run and jump. I do not eat but I swim and stretch. I do not drink but I sleep and stand. I do not think but I grow and play. I do not see but you see me everyday?
I do not contain flesh, feather, or scales; yet I have fingers and thumbs. What am I?
I do not have eyes but I once could see. I used to have thoughts but now I'm empty. What am I?
I do not speak but there is no word I cannot make. What am I?
I don't forget! What am I?
I don't live within a house, nor do I live without. Most will use me when they come in and again when they go out. What am I?
I don't think or eat or slumber. Or move around or fear thunder. Just like you I look the same but I can't harm you or be your bane?
I drift forever with the current and flows to your everyday life. I make living easy but I am good at killing people too. What am I?

I drift forever with the current down these long canals they’ve made, Tame, yet wild, I run elusive Multitasking to your aid. Before I came, the world was darker, colder, sometimes, rougher, true. But though I might make living easy, I’m good at killing people too?
I drive men mad for love of me, easily beaten, Never free?
I drive men mad for love of me. Easily beaten, never free?
I drive men mad for the love of me. Easily beaten, never free. What am I?
I eat as you turn me, my blade cutting wood. When I am full, empty me you should. What am I?
I eat, I live, I breathe, I live, I drink, I die. What am I?
I enclose you in darkness but allow you to see many things. If you resist me, you're likely to get rings. What am I?
